blurb: Guests fish for redfish and other species using sight-fishing techniques or spin casting with professional guides. Trips operate year-round in the Biloxi Marsh and coastal areas near New Orleans. Bird watching tours explore the prolific marshlands with expert guidance and include a bottle of Prosecco.
